beats.title: Two women, two men
beats.detail: The four leave together; Aditi leads bolder-than-EP02 double-meaning flirting, and Avi/Yash each tease both women. Meenakshi participates rather than just watching.

beats.title: Meenakshi offers the ride
beats.detail: She suggests using her own car and drives the group to the farmhouse; teasing continues en route.

beats.title: One-glass challenge
beats.detail: Meenakshi first refuses alcohol, then freely agrees to one glass of wine after light group encouragement. Other three drink more moderately. Her one glass is taken at the start, but does not justify driving later.

beats.title: Aditi sets the temperature
beats.detail: Aditi confidently flirts with both men and dances first. All three watch and appreciate her look; Avi's interest and the mutual teasing become more openly apparent.

beats.title: Avi–Aditi chemistry
beats.detail: Avi joins for a close dance; hand movements, held hands, near faces, and back-to-chest positions remain consensual, with no kissing.

beats.title: Yash joins
beats.detail: Aditi, Avi, Yash dance together with friendly close movement and playful responses; Aditi remains an active lead.

beats.title: Meenakshi joins later
beats.detail: The group invites her and she chooses to dance. Avi notices the fitted kurta and her peach-rounded hip curve as she crosses the floor; Yash notices her hourglass waist, steps and changes of expression. Their distinct private glances are visual observations, not permission; Aditi also notices the change in the group's attention.

beats.title: Crossed attention
beats.detail: Bold double-meaning remarks from all four and shifting attention toward both women. Meenakshi's outward humour and inward surprise/attraction are distinguished; any exact Naveen memory depends on unwritten EP04.

beats.title: Aditi's dress and boundaries
beats.detail: Aditi gets styling compliments. A mischievous attempted glance beneath the mini-dress does not reveal anything; this is framed as a private boundary crossing, not as invitation or consensual exposure.

beats.title: Aditi's suggestion
beats.detail: She initiates multiple group and pair photographs with smiles, hand-in-hand positions and close poses. Images are private, no publication/posting presumed.

beats.title: Waist-contact trust
beats.detail: Avi/Aditi close poses and Yash/Meenakshi photo. Yash explicitly asks before placing his hand at Meenakshi's waist. She allows the photo pose; that permission is limited to it.

beats.title: Avi's jealousy
beats.detail: Avi notices Yash getting unusually comfortable with Meenakshi, privately feels jealousy. Aditi detects Avi's shift despite their earlier flirtation.

beats.title: Meenakshi and Yash
beats.detail: Their talk remains personal and flirtatious, not converted into a locker investigation. Meenakshi's emotional continuity must incorporate the unwritten post-14:15 Naveen scene.

beats.title: Aditi must leave
beats.detail: Aditi has another engagement and arranges a separate cab; Avi and Yash request a drop from Meenakshi, and she agrees.

beats.title: Who sits next to Meenakshi?
beats.detail: With a sober driver at the wheel, the only rear seat beside Meenakshi becomes contested. Yash takes it before Avi; Avi takes the front passenger seat. Meenakshi and Aditi see the rivalry and laugh, then Aditi leaves.

beats.title: Unspoken looks
beats.detail: Avi catches the peach-round silhouette of Meenakshi's hips as she changes seat position; Yash separately notices the gentle hourglass line of her waist and how she adjusts her plum kurta. These are distinct, private adult-admiration metaphors; each man exchanges a teasing glance, and Meenakshi does not know exactly what was noticed.

beats.title: Fitness-flirt challenge
beats.detail: A playful abs/fitness conversation becomes a voluntary challenge. Meenakshi explicitly offers limited clothed abdomen contact, individually for Avi and Yash; she assumes the contact stays over clothing.

beats.title: Avi's turn
beats.detail: Brief, roughly 30-second clothed abdomen-contact beat; playful conversation, with Meenakshi setting the scope.

beats.title: Yash's unexpected direct contact
beats.detail: A shift of Meenakshi's seat posture while retrieving her phone lifts the edge of the plum kurta. Yash's fingers accidentally slip just under the edge toward her abdomen, differing from her assumption of over-clothing contact. She is briefly surprised and tense; he pauses and checks her comfort. She consciously agrees to continued direct abdomen contact for up to about one minute. Her reaction is private and conflicted; do not portray her silence as consent or turn the outline into explicit prose.

beats.title: Quiet aftermath
beats.detail: The encounter ends; they adjust posture and say little. No escalation or kiss. The car resumes toward the drop-off.

beats.title: Avi jokingly kicks Yash
beats.detail: Both men exit. Avi mock-jealously gives Yash a light, playful kick for the seating/attention rivalry; Yash jokes back. Meenakshi sees them from the car and smiles shyly.

beats.title: Three memories — not home yet
beats.detail: Meenakshi continues toward home with the sober driver. Her mind moves among Naveen's unresolved afternoon continuation, Avi's open flirtation/jealousy, Yash's closer personal encounter, and her awareness of the wine. Stop before home arrival.

paragraphs.text: Hospital staff exit ke bahar shaam ki halki roshni mein chaaron log ikatthe hue. Aditi white coat ke neeche fitted black shirt aur straight trousers mein khadi thi, baal loosely tied, posture seedha aur nazar confidently aage. Avi dark shirt ke sleeves roll karke uske saamne aaya. Yash thodi doori pe khada tha, expression relaxed. Meenakshi plum kurta, cream palazzo aur grey cardigan mein unke paas pahunchi, keys haath mein.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Avi, hospital mein toh bade disciplined rehte ho. Aaj dance floor pe meri pace match kar paoge?
Avi ne uski nazar se nazar milayi. Woh expected kar raha tha normal baat, lekin Aditi ka tone seedha aur testing tha.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Tum pace badhaogi toh mujhe bhi apna best dena padega.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Best dena. Excuses mat dena. Main performance yaad rakhti hoon.
Avi pehle jawab dena chaha, lekin Aditi ke steady eye contact ne use ek pal ke liye rok diya. Uske lips pe halki smile aayi, phir gayab ho gayi. Meenakshi ne uska badalta expression notice kiya.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Meenakshi ma’am, lagta hai Avi ko aaj extra training chahiye.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Training se zyada concentration. Aditi abhi warm-up mein hai aur yeh already nervous hai.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Nervous mat samajhna. Main sirf dekh rahi hoon kaun kitna der tak saath de sakta hai.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Dekh lena. Main aaj sirf dekhne nahi aaya.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Aditi, tum toh already floor set kar rahi ho. Hum log abhi sirf audience hain.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Audience nahi. Participants. Meenakshi drive kar rahi hain. Tum dono peeche baithna… taaki main aage se tumhe dekh sakun.
Meenakshi ne keys uthayi aur group ki taraf ishara kiya.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Chalo. Parking door hai. Zyada der mat lagao.

Aditi ne Avi ki taraf ek last, deliberate look diya aur pehle kadam badhaya. Avi uske peeche chala, lekin ab uski chaal pehle jaisi relaxed nahi thi. Yash ne Meenakshi ke saath side se chalna shuru kiya.

paragraphs.text: Guest room se Aditi bahar aayi. Warm string lights uske burgundy mini-dress pe pad rahi thin. Thin straps uske shoulders pe the, deep neckline collarbones se neeche tak clearly dikh raha tha. Short hem mid-thigh ke upar tha. Jaise hi woh seating ki taraf badhi, dress ka satin fabric uske steps ke saath uski thighs pe shift hua, hem thoda sa upar uth ke wapas settle hua.
Avi ne glass table pe rakh diya. Uski nazar pehle neckline pe ruki, phir waist pe, phir legs pe.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Aditi… yeh dress tum pe jaan-bujh ke fit kiya hua lag raha hai. Neckline se lekar hem tak, har movement dikh rahi hai.
Aditi ne kadam dheeme rakhe; uski nazar Avi aur Yash ke expressions par thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Jaan-bujh ke hi pehna hai. Aaj professional look nahi chahiye tha.
Yash ne uske shoulders aur neatly styled updo ko notice kiya.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Hairstyle bhi badla hai. Yeh updo tumhara look complete kar raha hai.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Notice kiya. Achha hai.
Meenakshi sofe pe baithi thi. Usne Aditi ko junior resident se is glamorous hostess mein badalte dekha — fitted silhouette, confident walk, short hem ke movement. Kuch nahi kaha.
Aditi unke beech mein aayi, hips ka natural sway dress ke saath clearly dikh raha tha. Avi ab bhi usko dekh raha tha. Yash ne glass uthaya lekin nazar nahi hatayi.

F04.endBoundary: F04 ends on Aditi coming between the group; F05 begins with her invitation to Avi. No F04 dance invitation remains.

F02.title: Meenakshi Offers the Ride
F02.approvalNotes: Author-approved F01–F04 compacted Grok original, with exact deletions and inline replacements accepted 15 Nov 2026. Grok raw archive unchanged; selected source episode-03-meenakshi-scene-02-grok-originals.json -> author-selected.json.

paragraphs.text: Meenakshi ne parking mein ruk ke group ki taraf dekha.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Main apni car le aayi hoon. Main drive karungi. Chalo.
Aditi bina der kiye front passenger seat pe baith gayi. Avi aur Yash peeche settle hue. Meenakshi ne engine start kiya aur car dheere se bahar nikal gayi.
Avi ne uski taraf dekha, tone confident.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Theek hai. Pehli dance meri hogi. Tum sirf haath dena… aur dekhna main kitni der tak tumhe apne pace pe rakhti hoon.
Avi hasa, lekin uski aankhon mein ab interest clearly dikh raha tha.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Aditi, tumne Avi ko already select kar liya. Main line mein hoon ya wait karun?

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Line mein ho. Lekin agar tum slow ho gaye toh main tumhe skip bhi kar sakti hoon.
Meenakshi steering pe haath rakhe road dekh rahi thi. Uske lips pe halki smile thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Aditi, tum peeche baithe logon ko already dance floor pe khada kar rahi ho. Gaadi abhi road pe hai.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Meenakshi, main sirf unhe ready kar rahi hoon. Tum drive karo. Main baaki ka kaam farmhouse pe kar lungi.

Car aage badhti rahi. Aditi front seat pe baithi thi, professional outfit mein, lekin uska tone aur nazar peeche baithe dono logon ko clearly involve kar rahi thi. Meenakshi ne mirror mein unki expressions ek baar dekhi, phir wapas road pe focus kiya. Usko unki baatein sun ke maza aa raha tha, lekin woh driving se nahi hati.

F03.title: The One-Glass Challenge
F03.approvalNotes: Author-approved F01–F04 compacted Grok original, with exact deletions and inline replacements accepted 15 Nov 2026. Grok raw archive unchanged; selected source episode-03-meenakshi-scene-02-grok-originals.json -> author-selected.json.

paragraphs.text: Farmhouse pahunchkar Aditi ne chaaron ko string lights ke neeche seating area tak lead kiya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Aao. Drinks yahan hain. Music ready hai. Guest room bhi available hai agar kisi ko change karna ho.
Usne table pe wine aur juice ke glasses set kiye. Avi aur Yash sofe pe baith gaye. Meenakshi thodi doori pe khadi rahi.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Mujhe juice de do. Wine nahi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Juice theek hai. Ek game khelte hain — ek glass, ek honest answer. Main sawal poochhungi; jiska mann ho, woh jawab dega.
Meenakshi ne Aditi ki taraf dekha.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Yeh rule tumne abhi socha hai, ya pehle se plan tha?

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Abhi socha. Kyunki tumne juice maanga. Main dekhna chahti hoon tum hum sab ko kitna closely dekh rahi ho.
Avi hasa. Yash ne glass uthaya lekin peena nahi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Toh pehla sawal. Hospital mein kaun sabse behtar hai is baat mein ki woh notice nahi kar raha… jab koi usse zyada dekh raha ho?
Avi ne seedha jawab diya.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Yeh toh easy hai. Yash. Woh hamesha side se dekhte rehte hain.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Main side se dekh raha hoon ya tum openly baat kar rahe ho, yeh alag baat hai. Meenakshi ma’am, aap kya kehti hain?
Meenakshi ne thodi der socha, phir calmly kaha.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Dono alag hain. Ek openly flirt karta hai taaki doosra notice kare. Doosra quietly dekhta hai taaki pehla uncomfortable na ho. Farq yeh hai ki pehla jaanta hai usse dekha ja raha hai. Doosra sochta hai koi nahi dekh raha.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Achha answer. Matlab tum dono ko pehle se dekh rahi thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Main doctor hoon. Logon ko observe karna meri aadat hai. Farmhouse pe bhi wahi kaam karti hoon.
Aditi hasli. Usne ek glass wine uthaya aur Meenakshi ki taraf badhaya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Ab tum decide karo. Juice pe rehna hai ya ek glass leke is game mein aana hai. Koi pressure nahi.
Meenakshi ne glass dekha, phir Aditi ki nazar. Thodi der baad usne glass le liya.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Ek glass. Sirf isliye kyunki tumne sawal poochha. Ab main bhi sunna chahti hoon tum log kya sochte ho.
Avi ne apna glass uthaya. Yash ne bhi. Teeno ne ek-ek sip liya. Meenakshi ne apna glass haath mein rakha, peena abhi nahi shuru kiya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Main thodi der ke liye guest room ja rahi hoon. Change karke aati hoon. Tum log settle ho jao. Music on hai.

Woh guest room ki taraf badhi, professional outfit abhi bhi pehne hue. Avi uske jaate hue dekhta raha. Yash ne Meenakshi ki taraf dekha — uske haath mein ab wine ka glass tha, lekin uski nazar ab bhi group pe thi. Meenakshi ne ek chhota sip liya aur sofe pe baith gayi. Farmhouse mein ab sirf teeno log the, aur Aditi ke wapas aane ka intezaar.

paragraphs.text: Aditi ne Yash ki taraf haath badhaya. Woh abhi bhi Avi ke dance se thodi saans le rahi thi, burgundy dress uske body se chipka hua tha.
Yash. Tum bhi aa jao.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Yash ne glass side pe rakha aur aage badha. Usne kuch nahi kaha. Seedha Aditi ke peeche aa gaya. Avi abhi bhi saamne tha. Aditi beech mein sandwich ho gayi.

Aditi ne palatkar Yash ko dekha. Avi ke saath har step pe baat hoti rahi thi; Yash ki khamoshi mein kuch alag tha. Usne abhi tak ek bhi compliment nahi diya tha, phir bhi uski entry ne dance ka rhythm badal diya.
Itni der chup the. Ab bina warning ke lead lene aa gaye?
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Tum dono ka dance dekh raha tha. Kab bolna hai, usse zyada zaroori tha kab aana hai.
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Yash ne Aditi ki taraf apna haath badhaya. Aditi ne khud use thaama. Agli beat par usne unhe ek saaf turn mein guide kiya; Avi ek step hatkar unke saamne aa gaya. Aditi ko surprise hua ki Yash music mein itna sure-footed hai, aur is baar woh khushi se uski lead follow karne lagi.
Hospital mein toh tum itne quiet rehte ho.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Wahan tum meri senior ho. Yahan tumne khud dance ke liye bulaya hai.
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Aditi ki hansi nikli. Avi ne bhi muskurane ki koshish ki, lekin usne pehli baar notice kiya ki Yash bina badi-badi baaton ke Aditi ko waqai surprise kar raha tha.
Yash, tumne toh apna best move chhupa kar rakha tha.
paragraphs.speaker: Avi

paragraphs.text: Sab pehle hi dikha doon toh surprise kis baat ka?
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Music thoda slow hua. Yash ne agle turn ke baad Aditi ko rukne ki jagah di. Woh uski taraf mudhi, ab curious thi ki yeh shaant sa trainee aur kya unexpected kar sakta hai.
Ek chhoti si gustakhi poochh sakta hoon?
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Pehle batao kaisi.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Yash ki nazar ek pal uske kandhe ki taraf gayi. Aditi ne baat samjhi aur halki si muskurahat ke saath sir hila diya.
Ek baar. Uske baad dance pe dhyan.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Yash ne uske kandhe par ek halki kiss di aur turant thoda peeche ho gaya. Aditi ek pal ke liye still hui—surprise gesture se kam, Yash ke poochhne aur phir bilkul theek waqt par ruk jaane se zyada tha. Agli beat par woh khud uske saath turn mein aa gayi.
Achha, Avi. Tumne ise itna shaant samajh kaise liya?
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Maine samjha tha yeh sirf dekhne aaya hai. Galat nikla.
paragraphs.speaker: Avi

paragraphs.text: Meenakshi sofa se dekh rahi thi. Avi ke har emotion ka chehre par aana aasaan tha; Yash ne toh bolne se pehle poora dance dekh liya tha. Usne Aditi ki surprised smile aur Avi ki badli hui nazar, dono note kiye.

Aditi ne ek aur halka turn liya, phir dono men se thodi door hatkar Meenakshi ki taraf dekha. Uski muskurahat mein agle gaane ka naya khayal tha—abhi invitation nahi, bas ek nazar. Dance ka agla hissa ab kisi aur ko bhi involve kar sakta tha.

F06.endBoundary: F06 ends with Yash's unexpected active lead, one explicitly welcomed brief shoulder kiss, Avi's reaction and Aditi glancing toward Meenakshi. F07 invitation/Meenakshi dance not written.

F07.title: Meenakshi Joins Later

paragraphs.text: Aditi ne Meenakshi ki taraf dekha, jo abhi bhi sofe par baithi thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Meena, tum bhi aa jao. Sirf dekhte rehna nahi.

Meenakshi ne apna glass side par rakha. Ek pal socha, phir uth khadi hui. Plum kurta uski fitted waist par set tha, cream palazzo neeche soft flow kar raha tha. Usne grey cardigan utaar kar sofa ke paas rakh diya. Dance floor ki taraf badhte hue uski measured chaal mein kurte ka fabric uske rounded hip silhouette ke saath halka sa move hua.

Avi ki nazar Meenakshi ke gait aur kurte ki shifting silhouette par gayi. Yash ne alag cheez notice ki—hourglass waist, steps ka balance aur uske calm expression mein music ke saath aata chhota sa badlav.
Aditi ne dono ki nazar ka shift pakad liya aur hansi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Achha, ab attention share ho rahi hai?

Meenakshi unke paas pahunchi. Aditi ne uska haath thaama aur ek slow turn guide kiya. Meenakshi ne apni rhythm mein steps milaye; jaldi nahin ki. Avi aur Yash unke saamne jagah banate hue dance mein saath rahe.
Aditi ki hansi ab bhi sabse khulkar sunai de rahi thi. Meenakshi ko bhi is relaxed atmosphere mein shamil hona achha lag raha tha; woh ab sirf audience nahi thi.

F08.title: Crossed Attention

paragraphs.text: Dance chalta raha. Aditi ne Avi ki taraf dekha, jiski nazar ab kabhi uspar toh kabhi Meenakshi ki taraf ja rahi thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Avi, tumhari nazar ab Meena par bhi ja rahi hai. Pehle poori meri taraf thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Dono dance kar rahi ho. Dekhne ko toh dono mil rahi ho.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Dono ko dekh rahe ho, ya compare kar rahe ho?
Avi ek pal ke liye atak gaya. Meenakshi ne baat suni aur uski taraf dekha.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Compare karne ki zaroorat nahi. Main yahan dance karne aayi hoon, judge hone nahi.
Yash Meenakshi ke paas aaya, magar usne baat dance ki jagah uske mood se shuru ki.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Hospital mein aapko itna relaxed kabhi nahi dekha. Aaj kaunsa version asli hai?

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Dono. Kaam ke waqt strict rehna padta hai. Har waqt nahi.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Achha hai. Phir aaj mujhe ek nayi Meenakshi se milne ka mauka mila.
Meenakshi ne halki si smile di. Woh apne jawab se zyada Yash ke sawaal ki sincerity par surprised thi. Avi ne dono ko baat karte dekha; Aditi ki nazar us par laut aayi.

Music ke agle phrase mein Aditi ne Avi ka haath khud pakda aur turn karte hue uske saamne se uske paas aa gayi. Ek pal ke liye usne use apni taraf guide kiya; Avi itni sudden closeness expect nahi kar raha tha. Uska step ruk gaya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Abhi tak toh bade confidently jawab de rahe the. Ab itne chup kyun ho?

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Tumne surprise kar diya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Achha. Toh aaj ka ek surprise mera bhi sahi.

Aditi ne agle beat par khud distance badha di aur phir se dance mein aa gayi. Avi ke chehre ki jhijhak dekh kar Yash muskura diya. Meenakshi ne bhi woh chhota sa exchange notice kiya: Aditi ab bhi apni marzi se dance ka rhythm aur proximity decide kar rahi thi.
Chaaron ke beech attention badal rahi thi, lekin kisi ko bhi us badlav ka seedha naam dene ki jaldi nahi thi.

F08.endBoundary: Aditi initiates a surprising brief close dance turn with Avi; positions and restored distance remain clear. F09 is a separate boundary incident.

F09.title: Aditi's Dress and Boundaries

paragraphs.text: Aditi ne agla gaana bhi khud lead kiya. Ek turn ke baad Avi ne uski burgundy mini-dress ki taraf dekha.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Burgundy dress mein tumhari styling waqai standout kar rahi hai. Dance ke saath fabric bhi alag tarah move karta hai.

Aditi ne smile ki, lekin agle hi step par Avi ki nazar dress ke hem se neeche ek aisi angle dhoondhne lagi jo ek normal compliment se alag thi. Use kuch nazar nahi aaya. Aditi ne foran notice kiya aur ruk gayi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Neeche mat dekho. Jo dikh raha hai, wahi hai. Jo nahi dikh raha, woh tumhare liye nahi hai.
Avi ne turant nazar utha li aur ek step peeche hua.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Sorry. Galat tha.
Yash chup raha. Meenakshi ne bhi Aditi ko dekha. Woh samajh gayi thi ki dance mein Aditi ka kisi ko paas bulana aur uski personal boundary cross karna alag baatein hain.
Aditi ne ek pal baad phir se music pakda. Is baar Avi ne distance banaye rakha. Aditi ne apne steps se shaam ka mood wapas set kiya—bina apni baat wapas liye.

F09.endBoundary: F09 boundary clearly asserted and respected. F10 photograph idea not yet written.

F01.title: Two Women, Two Men
F01.approvalNotes: Author approved Grok revised beat with three editorial edits: remove repeated 'control' dialogue, move seating to F02, cut repetitive final internal explanation. F02–F22 remain plot-only.

paragraphs.text: Hospital staff exit ke bahar shaam ki halki roshni mein chaaron log ikatthe hue. Aditi white coat ke neeche fitted black shirt aur straight trousers mein khadi thi, baal loosely tied, posture seedha aur nazar confidently aage. Avi dark shirt ke sleeves roll karke uske saamne aaya. Yash thodi doori pe khada tha, expression relaxed. Meenakshi plum kurta, cream palazzo aur grey cardigan mein unke paas pahunchi, keys haath mein.
Avi, hospital mein toh bade disciplined rehte ho. Aaj dance floor pe meri pace match kar paoge?
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Avi ne uski nazar se nazar milayi. Woh normal baat expect kar raha tha, lekin Aditi ka tone seedha aur testing tha.
Tum pace badhaogi toh mujhe bhi apna best dena padega.
paragraphs.speaker: Avi

paragraphs.text: Best dena. Excuses mat dena. Main performance yaad rakhti hoon.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Avi jawab dene wala tha, lekin Aditi ke steady eye contact ne use ek pal ke liye rok diya. Meenakshi ne uska badalta expression notice kiya.
Meenakshi ma'am, lagta hai Avi ko aaj extra training chahiye.
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Training se zyada concentration. Aditi abhi warm-up mein hai aur yeh already nervous hai.
paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi

paragraphs.text: Aditi hans padi. Avi ne Meenakshi ki taraf dekha—ab use samajh aa gaya tha ki aaj teasing sirf ek taraf se nahi hone wali.
Avi, tumhari aankhon mein confidence toh hai. Bas dance floor pe meri aankhon se nazar mat churana.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Tum saamne rahogi toh nazar hatane ka sawaal hi nahi.
paragraphs.speaker: Avi

paragraphs.text: Aditi ki smile gehri hui. Is baar Avi ne jawab dene mein der nahi lagayi.
Aditi, tum toh already floor set kar rahi ho. Hum log abhi sirf audience hain.
paragraphs.speaker: Yash

paragraphs.text: Audience nahi, Yash. Participants.
paragraphs.speaker: Aditi

paragraphs.text: Meenakshi ne keys uthayi aur group ki taraf ishara kiya.
Chalo. Parking door hai. Zyada der mat lagao.
paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi

paragraphs.text: Aditi parking ki taraf badhi. Avi uske saath chalne laga. Is baar Aditi ne khud uski taraf dekha aur muskura di. Meenakshi ne woh exchange notice kiya, lekin kuch kaha nahi. Chaaron parking ki taraf badh gaye.

F01.endBoundary: All four walk toward parking. No car seating, engine start or drive prose yet; F02 is next.

F04.title: Aditi Sets the Temperature
F04.location: Farmhouse · Guest-room exit and dance area
F04.approvalNotes: Published per author instruction after 4 agreed editorial edits: reference hairstyle updo; more natural bold compliment; Meenakshi reaction; Aditi dances solo before inviting Avi. F02–F03 remain unapproved and unpublished.

paragraphs.text: Guest room se Aditi bahar aayi. Warm string lights uske burgundy mini-dress par pad rahi thin. Thin straps uske shoulders par the; deep neckline aur fitted waist uske party look ko alag hi confidence de rahe the. Short hem mid-thigh ke upar tha. Jaise hi woh seating ki taraf badhi, satin fabric uske steps ke saath halka sa move hua, phir settle ho gaya.
Avi ne apna glass table par rakh diya. Uski nazar Aditi ke naye look par ruki; Yash bhi palatkar dekhne laga.

paragraphs.speaker: Avi
paragraphs.text: Aditi, burgundy tum par kamaal lag raha hai. Aur woh neckline, fitted waist aur short hem… tumne aaj sabka attention apne naam kar liya.
Aditi ne ek kadam aur badhaya. Uski aankhon mein shararat thi.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Achha? Aur main toh abhi dance floor par gayi bhi nahi.

paragraphs.speaker: Yash
paragraphs.text: Aur hairstyle bhi change kiya hai. Yeh updo tumhare poore look ko aur elegant bana raha hai.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Tum details achhi notice karte ho, Yash.
Meenakshi sofe par baithi thi. Usne Aditi ko hospital ki junior resident se party ki confident hostess bante dekha—outfit alag tha, lekin uska self-assurance wahi tha.

paragraphs.speaker: Meenakshi
paragraphs.text: Aditi, hospital wali tumhe pehchanna mushkil ho raha hai. Dress genuinely stunning hai.
Meenakshi ka compliment sunkar Aditi khush hui aur ek chhota sa turn le liya. Mini-dress ka satin hem uske movement ke saath hila. Avi ki smile aur gehri ho gayi.

Music ki beat badli. Aditi ne apna glass table par rakha aur dance floor ki taraf badhi. Pehle usne akele kuch confident steps liye. Ek turn ke saath uski burgundy dress ki short hemline halki si move hui. Avi aur Yash dono usse dekh rahe the.
Phir Aditi ne Avi ki taraf haath badhaya.

paragraphs.speaker: Aditi
paragraphs.text: Ab dekhna band karoge, ya dance bhi karoge?

F04.endBoundary: F04 ends with Aditi already dancing on her own and offering Avi her hand. F05 begins with Avi joining; no close dance prose in F04.
